notes.title: King's League II - The Winterhush Update 4.0.0
notes.content:
[u][b]A Brand New Story Campaign[/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34281092/59c3a1a4cc39e35f453f60bd8eadac65e1028bc4.png[/img]

Join Ivo, the Human Magician, on a quest for power and secrets. Recruit new characters, learn more about Prism, and witness a pivotal point in King's League history.

8 new playable Fighter Classes have been added, including:
[list][*] Conjurer
[*] Elementalist
[*] Pugilist
[*] Monk
[*] Swordsman
[*] Swordsmaster
[*] Swashbuckler
[*] Duelist[/list]

[u][b]A Brand New Game Mode[/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34281092/324810c723f8e623127c3bb14b72da390cc8e765.png[/img]

Crest Mode is a brand-new way to experience King’s League II with randomisation being a core element, pushing players to adapt and strategise to win.
[list][*] In this mode, your goal is to collect enough Crests to proceed in the leagues.
[*] Select units, perks, items and even the leagues you want to join. Build the best team possible!
[*] Unit Perks have been added, granting bonuses to your team units in battle.
[*] Facility Perks have been added, granting various bonuses to training, quests, dungeons, recruitment, and so on.
[*] 20 new Leagues have been added in Crest Mode, with special modifiers, team formats, rewards, and more!
[*] 22 new items have been added in Crest Mode that you can either earn as rewards or purchased through the Market.
[*] Earn more Prestige as you succeed in Crest Mode and face tougher challenges with each level you climb higher. Can you emerge victorious in Prestige X?[/list]

[u][b]Classic Mode[/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34281092/20dde73eca65d41d73c473e1a01d0b64cc600a20.png[/img]

4 new Classic Mode Leaders have been added:
[list][*] Ivo the Conjurer
[*] Darqul the Pugilist
[*] Leon the Swordsman
[*] Jo the Swashbuckler[/list]
8 new Special Events have been added.

[u][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/u]
[list][*] Potentially fixed an issue where the game would get stuck loading a saved game with certain situations showing no buttons or menus on the screen.
[*] Fixed an issue where certain tutorials could not be completed using a controller.
[*] Fixed an issue where the game would get stuck after exiting a Dungeon followed by opening any menus.
[*] Fixed an issue where the game would get stuck during certain tutorials when spamming either the Space, Escape or Left Mouse buttons.
[*] Fixed an issue where insufficient faction quests were offered monthly in Classic Mode and Crest Mode.
[*] Fixed an issue where progress in a Dungeon could be saved midway when quitting the game in certain situations.
[*] Fixed an issue during a certain story battle involving Raulin where the dialogue could get stuck.
[*] Fixed an issue in Story Mode where units were not revived during certain story battles.
[*] Fixed an issue with Recruitment where certain units could no longer be recruited after most available units had been recruited.
[*] Fixed an issue with Recruitment where the list of units available to recruit were not always as expected.
[*] Fixed an issue where saved games were not showing the correct league names.
[*] Fixed an issue in the Unit Management menu where deselected units were shown incorrectly after removing all selections with an active filter.
[*] Fixed an issue in the Unit Management menu where selecting a unit via drag-and-drop would also select an unintended additional unit.
[*] Fixed an issue in the Unit Management menu where the unit selections malfunctioned when entering the Triwagon Tourney in certain situations.
[*] Fixed a visual issue where units defeated in Eolin's Arena did not appear defeated in subsequent battles.
[*] Fixed an issue where tooltips for Glory and Favour emblems in the Team Profile menu were not shown on mobile devices.
[*] Fixed an issue where the tooltip text did not fit correctly in the tooltips for Glory and Favour emblems in the Team Profile menu.
[*] Fixed an issue in the Main Menu where the main characters were shown posing incorrectly in certain situations.
[*] Fixed a localisation issue with the Team Profile menu in Classic Mode.
[*] Fixed a localisation issue in the Main Menu Settings where the King's League II text was not translated in certain situations.
[*] Fixed an issue with the notification icon on the Recruitment button showing when there were no available units to recruit.
[*] Fixed a localisation issue with the Credits menu in Japanese.[/list]

notes.title: King's League II Minor Update: 2.0.8
notes.content:
[b]King’s League II: End-of-Year Update[/b]

[b]Version 2.0.8 - Build 10296[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed a crashing issue that would occur when continuing a Story Mode game after completing the King's League.
[*] Fixed a crashing issue that would occur when using Tristan's skill just before his health reaches 0.
[*] Fixed an issue where the "Dauntless" Glory and "Fast Fists" Glory were not unlocking correctly.
[*] Fixed an issue where the effects of "Constant Healing" and "Constant Draining" in the Battlethon would persist after the battle was over.
[*] Fixed an issue where the "Arsenal Ace" achievement description was inaccurate.
[*] Fixed an issue where certain equipment items had incorrect stats and descriptions.
[*] Fixed an issue where Thief units would have an incorrect state when the unit's skill gets interrupted by Captain Mammon's skill.
[*] Fixed an issue where an incorrect dialogue option was shown in the "Shadow or Secret" event with Mistelle during Maxwell's story campaign.
[*] Fixed an issue where the condition for entering Aldor's Golem Clash was stated incorrectly in Sella's story campaign.
[*] Fixed an issue where the dialogues after achieving a Reputation level for each Faction could be missed if the game was closed during the dialogue.
[*] Fixed an issue where Mistelle's introduction dialogue did not play in certain situations.
[*] Fixed an issue where the dialogue did not mention the amount of rewards received after completing each tier of Eolin's Arena during Maxwell's story campaign.
[*] Fixed a rare issue where it was not possible to proceed through the "Upgrade Facilities" tutorial in certain situations.
[*] Fixed an issue where unit stats displayed in the Unit Management menu were inaccurate in certain situations.
[*] Fixed an issue where units would be positioned incorrectly in the Unit Management menu.
[*] Fixed an issue where the round description texts in the Battlethon were incorrect for the "-50% Skill Cooldown" and "+100% Skill Cooldown" rounds.
[*] Fixed an issue where the mouse cursor would sometimes reappear during cutscenes.
[*] Fixed an issue where the controller was not responding in certain situations during the "Welcoming Gift" Event.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Upgrade button in the Unit Upgrade menu is clickable in certain situations when it should not have been.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Engage battle button area was not fully clickable.
[*] Fixed an issue where Class Advancement descriptions were displayed incorrectly for certain screen resolutions.
[*] Fixed an audio issue that was occurring when starting a battle that had the "No Skills" effect applied, such as during the Battlethon.
[*] Fixed a visual issue with the battle background during the Triwagon Tournament.
[*] Fixed a visual issue where units would play the incorrect training animation after cancelling a Recess.
[*] Fixed a visual issue where the Hunting training icon would go missing in certain places.
[*] Fixed an animation issue where Tyshia could get stuck in her skill's casting animation in certain situations.
[*] Fixed an issue where the word "Faevyn" would be highlighted incorrectly.
[*] Fixed an issue where the hint for unlocking the Adventurer's Dagger in the Market was missing.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Speed Up button was not animating correctly.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Reputation menu would behave unpredictably in certain situations.
[/list]

Please update to the latest version to get these fixes.

It's been a while since our last update for King's League II. With 2024 coming to a close, we wanted to take a moment to share some recent developments. Things can get a little hectic this time of the year, but we hope you've found some time to unwind - maybe even squeeze in a couple of gaming sessions!

As an indie team, juggling multiple projects has been a cornerstone of our journey. While this sometimes results in delays when we shift our focus between projects, we've been steadily growing and refining our craft since King's League II launched in 2019. Your patience and support through it all mean everything to us.

This update fixes most of the bugs you've reported and includes improvements based on your feedback. If we've missed anything - or if you spot any new bugs - do let us know. Your continued input helps us in making King's League II a better game. 

Looking ahead, we're excited for what's coming in 2025. The final campaign and a brand-new mode are in the works and we can't wait to share them with you. Stay tuned!

notes.title: King's League II - The Evensong Update 2.0.3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34281092/8402d2fe52df4387a6e0d12da5d6eddc139ac50a.png[/img]

[b]It's time for the Evensong! Our first free major expansion, the Evensong Update is coming to King's League II in Early August, 2020.[/b]

The Evensong Update includes a brand new story campaign, new characters and classes, and lots of new gameplay features! [b]All for free![/b]

[u][b]A Brand New Story Campaign[/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34281092/88d74f46fb2f2060e9dcefd8f589d10f5fef9c94.png[/img]

Join Sella the Aegle Bard on a journey of truth and trust. Meet new characters, learn more about Kurestal, and witness a different perspective of the King's League.

[u][b]8 New Playable Fighter Classes[/b][/u]

Try out various new classes with entirely unique skills, available both in Story Mode and Classic Mode.
[list][*] [b]Bard[/b], [i]advances to[/i] [b]Minstrel[/b]
[*] [b]Vanguard[/b], [i]advances to[/i] [b]Guardian[/b]
[*] [b]Trickster[/b], [i]advances to[/i] [b]Phantom[/b]
[*] [b]Crusader[/b], [i]advances to[/i] [b]Templar[/b][/list]

[u][b]Classic Mode: Battlethon[/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34281092/2e174a3de4785638960ed48bf43513e14531fd80.png[/img]

Enter the Battlethon, a new tournament of endless, ever-increasingly difficult battles with battlefield modifiers and random enemies. This feature is exclusive to Classic Mode.

[u][b]Classic Mode: Special Events[/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34281092/38e7f4c2a308492832337157e6fcd51b4c7c51c5.jpg[/img]

Special Events may appear on the World Map from time to time. Different events will appear every time you start a Classic Mode playthrough.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34281092/a735f092c527e2abbb1dafd30c0cecc3230f2c56.png[/img]

Participate in Special Events and make decisions that can gain you rewards or lose your resources. This feature is exclusive to Classic Mode.

[u][b]New Main Menu[/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34281092/5932053473e82eeb7a54e2ff9aabdcd86e1be0c1.png[/img]

With the addition of the Evensong Story Campaign, you can now select between two stories to play. To better reflect your progress, we're improving the Main Menu to dynamically change according to whether you have played or completed a Story Campaign.

[u][b]Story Mode Difficulties[/b][/u]

You can now select and play Story Mode campaigns in your choice of Casual, Normal or Expert difficulties!

[u][b]Thalia's Guidance and Objectives[/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34281092/503208a8cdcdd7a41c49caae33e8d91d2c25bfd3.jpg[/img]

Get extra rewards on the side by completing certain tasks! These are available in both Story Mode and Classic Mode.

[u][b]Under Siege[/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34281092/400bc7ef0e40c17f69cbf2bc39cc37664cfe9f39.png[/img]

Settlements that you own through completed Challenges may now come under siege by enemy teams! You must protect your settlements, or risk losing your Wardenship! This feature is available in both Story Mode and Classic Mode.

[u][b]Training Improvements[/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34281092/01d64d9fbb5f4751ba822156aafac3a362c2eb64.png[/img]

You can now see which of your units are in the middle of training when you manage or deploy your units.

[u][b]New Classic Mode Leaders[/b][/u]

There are an additional six more Leaders to choose from when you begin a new Classic Mode playthrough. They include:
[list][*] [i]Sella the Bard
[*] Philippe the Vanguard
[*] Fraylix the Trickster
[*] Herriot the Crusader
[*] Kiyo the Bowmaiden
[*] Peanut the Postknight[/i][/list]

[b]There are tons of new features and improvements, all to make your climbs towards becoming Champion all the smoother and more enjoyable![/b]

Let us know what you think!

We're already hard at work on our next update, so don't stop giving us your feedback! We really appreciate your thoughts, and we want to thank you for playing King's League II!

[b]Share your feedback and join the community on [url=https://discord.gg/HfRGw3d]our official Discord Server[/url].[/b]

Merry Christmas!

notes.title: King's League II - The Quality Update 1.2.1
notes.content:
[b]The Quality Update brings many requested features and improvements, including changes to Unit Management, simplified menu navigation, Class and Dungeon Boss balancing, and more.[/b]

[b]Unit Management has been reworked to make deployment your units easier, especially with large teams.[/b] You can save and switch between squads of units easily as well as compare all of your units in a list. You can also dismiss your units now!

[i][list][*] Added squad saving and switching, quickening the selection of units for deployment.
[*] Added Unit List to quickly compare units, equip items and dismiss unwanted units.
[*] Improved the unit filter to make finding units easier.
[*] Unit Management is now accessible on the Main screen (Menu screen for controllers).[/list][/i]
 
[b]Other interfaces have also been improved to simplify navigating through them.[/b] Menus like Recruitment and Quests are now easier to navigate, while the Market makes it easy to equip newly bought items.
 
[i][list][*] Simplified Recruitments to quicken navigation.
[*] Moved the "Cancel Training" button to avoid misclicks while training.
[*] Made Guilds clickable in Reputation, acting as shortcuts to their respective Perks pages.
[*] Added a choice to equip an item to a unit when purchasing them in the Market.
[*] Added Tool-tips while hovering over accessible locations on the Map.
[*] Added a display in Team Profile that shows what Emblems are equipped in Classic Mode.[/list][/i]
 
It's frustrating when the game restricts you or doesn't do a good job explaining something, so we're working on these issues. [b]Giving you a more freedom to use your time[/b] in Classic Mode will help you get those high ranks, while certain [b]elements are now easier to see and understand[/b].
 
[i][list][*] Added ticking sound effects before a League battle is about to start.
[*] Removed some restrictions from the "7 Days Remaining" period in Classic Mode.
[*] Made the Resource Gain animation end more quickly.
[*] Brightened the colour of different texts and buttons to make them stand out more.
[*] Added new Tutorials about Unit Management, Class Info and Pausing.[/list][/i]
 
[b]There is a huge batch of balancing changes this time around, all aimed at improving the overall experience of the game.[/b] Classic Mode is going to be more challenging, but rare units are now better and easier to find, making them all the better to look out for.
 
[i][list][*] Rebalanced Quest difficulty and Reputation gain to improve early progression.
[*] Rebalanced the overall difficulty of Classic Mode to make playthroughs more challenging.
[*] Increased the chances of finding rare units and improved the stats of rare units.[/list][/i]
 
[b]Many classes have been worked on to emphasize their individual strengths and weaknesses.[/b] We also don't want players beating Dungeon Bosses with their one lone ranged unit in the back. To promote diverse strategies, we've made Bosses do less damage, take more damage, and have improved skills that can hit everyone (including that lone ranged unit in the back).
 
[i][list][*] Tweaked damage and healing efficiency across many base classes.
[*] Rebalanced the Dungeon Bosses to do less damage and have more health.
[*] Increased the range of a skill to hit the whole battlefield for the Dungeon Boss Captain Mammon.
[*] Improved the AI for the Dungeon Boss Kuregon with more predictable attack patterns.
[*] Postal Charge and Blitz Charge will no longer push the Dungeon Boss Kuregon.[/list][/i]

So, what do you think?

There are many more updates on the horizon, so don't stop giving us your feedback! We really appreciate your thoughts, and we want to thank you for playing King's League II!

[b]Share your feedback and join the community on our [url=https://discord.gg/HfRGw3d]official Discord Server[/url].[/b]

notes.title: A Letter from the Director - 15/11/2019
notes.content:
[b]Hello, King’s League II players![/b]

I humbly thank you for playing King’s League II!

To the veteran players who have played the older King’s League games, welcome back! To the new players, welcome to the League! I hope that you all have some good times playing the game.

First off, we have to apologise for the launch hiccups and the game's imperfections. We want you, the players, to know that we are committed to making King’s League II the best game in the King’s League series.

We are listening to you. We have gone through all the feedback you have sent us. If you write us one, I thank you for your time and effort to help us improve the game!

As such, we have a plan for our next major update: [b]the Quality Update - Version 1.2[/b]. Coming sometime this [b]December[/b], we aim to improve different parts of the game. King’s League II is a simulation strategy game where your main interactions with the game include navigating through menus. By improving these menus, we believe that it will improve your experiences significantly.

Improvements include:
[list][*] The ability to dismiss fighters.
[*] Making Unit Selection remember your latest team setups.
[*] Increasing the speeds for 2x and 3x speed options.
[*] Quickened UI animations for rewards and more.
[*] Removing the 7-Day Limit from Classic Mode, adding reminders instead.
[*] Better Balancing to add more challenge where needed.
[*] Many Quality of Life updates for Challenges, Quests, Training, Armoury and more.[/list]

We will be focusing on these improvements over the next month. If you have additional feedback, [b]keep them coming[/b]! We would love to listen to what you have to say, all in our efforts to make King’s League II a better game.

And we won't stop there! Updates will continue to roll out over the next year or so, including new characters, classes, random events, story campaigns and more! I will share more with you after we release [b]the Quality Update - Version 1.2[/b].

Once again, thank you so much for supporting us. League on!

[i]Yiwei,
Director of King’s League II[/i]

[b]Share your feedback and join the community on our [url=https://discord.gg/HfRGw3d]official Discord Server[/url][/b]

notes.title: 👑KING’S LEAGUE II IS OUT NOW!👑
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34281092/870a0199392362a63576ab0560d0d98fcc35d717.png[/img]

The latest game from the Malaysian Indie Game Studio Kurechii, King's League II, is out now on Steam for PC players all over the world!

With the release to Steam, comes the game's first content update – The Classic Update. This update introduces an overhauled Team Creator to make each Classic Mode run different. This update will also be available to players on Apple Arcade.


[h1]The Classic Update[/h1]

With the introduction of Classic Mode Leaders and Emblems, you can play Classic Mode your way. Start with Story Mode characters like Maxwell and Daphne, or go entirely Classic with Tristan, the protagonist of King's League: Odyssey. Also, unlock Emblems as you play, giving you equipable traits and bonuses for your next play through.

[list][*] An overhauled Team Creator for Classic Mode.
[*] 9 Unlockable Classic Mode Leaders (with 2 more on the way!).
[*] 7 Glory Emblems, enabling different play styles in Classic Mode.
[*] 7 Favour Emblems, granting bonuses in your Classic Mode games.
[*] Tons of fixes and balance changes.[/list]
 

[h1]About King's League II[/h1]
 
King’s League II is the latest entry in a series of award-winning strategy simulation RPGs, starting with the browser flash game The King’s League (2011).

After decades of peace, the fires of combat are rekindled with the return of the King's League! Recruit fighters to your team, train them up and battle many foes as you climb the Leagues. Good team management and smart calendar planning will help as you become the Champions of Kurestal!

Once more, many join the esteemed Leagues to become the greatest fighters of Kurestal. King's League II takes on the addictive features of its critically-acclaimed predecessors and adds so much more to it. Everything has been rebuilt from the ground up, with an all new graphical look. There are new classes to try out, more battle types to play and even items to find and equip!

There is also a comprehensive Story Mode where you follow Maxwell and other interesting characters as they climb the Leagues and fight the mysterious threat known as the Infernal.

[i]This is the definitive King's League experience.[/i]


[h1]Features[/h1]

[list][*] A light yet deep simulation strategy game.
[*] More than 100 Fighters to recruit, each with different personalities.
[*] About 60 Classes with unique skills, looks and perks to try.
[*] Many upgrades to improve your team, allowing a ton of viable strategies.
[*] Leagues, Quests, Tournaments, Challenges and even Dungeons to fight through.
[*] Lots of choices to make, team compositions to try and replayability to enjoy.
[*] Engaging stories of interesting League participants becoming Champions.
[*] Entirely localized for 16 different languages, including Japanese, Russian, Arabic, and more.
[*] Has support for most popular gaming controllers.[/list]
